source.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI. doi:10.24432/C5BW33
source.transform: Drop missing customer IDs, cancellations, quantity<=0 and price<=0; sum positive line spend per invoice/customer/time. Forecast gross positive spend, not net revenue.
source.availability_assumption: Each invoice is available exactly 24 hours after its event timestamp; customer exists at its first available invoice. Naive source timestamps interpreted UTC, not verified source timezone.

limitations: All first-stage periods are exposed development comparisons and motivated this second stage.
Retail has no untouched later complete horizon; all its results are retrospective.
February Beijing is a small newly fixed temporal confirmation, not independent external validation.
Complete-case Beijing label filtering can bias included days.
Source availability clocks and timezones are experimental assumptions.
Entities recur; folds and outcome windows are dependent; no IID confidence intervals.
Process peak RSS is cumulative across loading and preceding fits, not per-model allocation.
Prediction timing excludes precompiled features; fit timing includes training feature compilation.
No final-test tuning, paid API/compute, raw-data redistribution or foundation-model claim.
